segments.text: தை மாதத்தில் பொங்கல் அன்று புதுப்பானையில் புத்தரிசி பொங்குவோம்.
segments.translation: In the month of Thai, on Pongal day, we cook the new rice in a new pot.

segments.text: பானையில் பால் பொங்கி வழியும் போது எல்லோரும் பொங்கலோ பொங்கல் என்று கூவுவோம்.
segments.translation: When the milk boils over the pot, everyone shouts Pongalo Pongal.

segments.text: முதலில் சூரியனுக்கும் பிறகு மாடுகளுக்கும் நன்றி சொல்வோம்.
segments.translation: First we give thanks to the sun, and then to the cattle.

segments.text: हमारी दादी हर शाम आँगन में बैठकर हमें लोरी सुनाती थीं।
segments.translation: Every evening our grandmother sat in the courtyard and sang us a lullaby.

segments.text: चाँद को मामा कहकर वह बच्चों को सुलाती थीं।
segments.translation: Calling the moon our maternal uncle, she put the children to sleep.

segments.text: उस लोरी में नदी, चिड़िया और चाँदनी की बातें होती थीं।
segments.translation: The lullaby spoke of the river, the birds and the moonlight.

segments.text: ఉగాది రోజున మేము ఉగాది పచ్చడి తయారు చేస్తాము.
segments.translation: On Ugadi day we make ugadi pachadi.

segments.text: అందులో బెల్లం, వేప పువ్వు, చింతపండు, మామిడి కలుపుతాము.
segments.translation: We add jaggery, neem flowers, tamarind and mango to it.

segments.text: జీవితంలో తీపి చేదు అన్నీ ఉంటాయని ఇది గుర్తు చేస్తుంది.
segments.translation: It reminds us that life holds both sweet and bitter.

segments.text: ഓണത്തിന് ഞങ്ങൾ മുറ്റത്ത് പൂക്കളം ഇടും.
segments.translation: At Onam we make a flower carpet in the courtyard.

segments.text: കുട്ടികൾ രാവിലെ തന്നെ തൊടിയിൽ പോയി പൂക്കൾ പറിക്കും.
segments.translation: The children go to the garden early in the morning to pick flowers.

segments.text: തിരുവോണത്തിന് എല്ലാവരും ചേർന്ന് വാഴയിലയിൽ സദ്യ കഴിക്കും.
segments.translation: On Thiruvonam everyone eats the feast together on banana leaves.

segments.text: বর্ষার দিনে আমরা নদীর ধারে বসে ভাটিয়ালি গান গাইতাম।
segments.translation: On rainy days we sat by the river and sang bhatiyali songs.

segments.text: মাঝিরা নৌকা বাইতে বাইতে এই গান গাইত।
segments.translation: The boatmen sang these songs as they rowed.

segments.text: গানে নদী আর মনের টানের কথা থাকত।
segments.translation: The songs spoke of the river and the pull of the heart.

segments.text: Mon grand-père pétrissait la pâte à pain tous les samedis matin.
segments.translation: My grandfather kneaded the bread dough every Saturday morning.

segments.text: Il disait qu'il faut laisser le levain se reposer toute la nuit.
segments.translation: He said the sourdough must be left to rest all night.

segments.text: Le four du village chauffait au bois de chêne.
segments.translation: The village oven was heated with oak wood.

segments.text: En septiembre toda la familia se reunía para la vendimia.
segments.translation: In September the whole family gathered for the grape harvest.

segments.text: Las abuelas cantaban coplas mientras cortaban los racimos.
segments.translation: The grandmothers sang folk verses while cutting the bunches.

segments.text: Al terminar el día compartíamos pan, queso y vino nuevo bajo la parra.
segments.translation: At the end of the day we shared bread, cheese and new wine under the vine.

segments.text: Na minha aldeia, os pescadores saíam ao mar antes do nascer do sol.
segments.translation: In my village the fishermen went out to sea before sunrise.

segments.text: As mulheres esperavam na praia e ajudavam a puxar as redes.
segments.translation: The women waited on the beach and helped pull in the nets.

segments.text: Quando o barco chegava, todos agradeciam ao mar com uma pequena oração.
segments.translation: When the boat came in, everyone thanked the sea with a short prayer.

segments.text: Every winter my aunt sewed a quilt from the worn-out saris of the women in our family.
Each patch carried a memory: a wedding, a festival, or a baby's first blanket.
She said a quilt is a family's story that you can wrap yourself in.
